courses.name: College Park Scholars: Global Public Health First-Year Colloquium I
courses.description: Introductory colloquium: Examination of factors that determine the health status of populations around the world.
courses.restrictions: Students must be enrolled in the College Park Scholars Global Public Health (CPGH) program

courses.name: College Park Scholars: Global Public Health First-Year Colloquium II
courses.description: Using case studies, students will examine necessary components to design successful public health interventions.
courses.restrictions: Students must be enrolled in the College Park Scholars Global Public Health (CPGH) program

courses.name: College Park Scholars: Global Public Health Second-Year Colloquium
courses.description: Building on knowledge and skills gained from the first-year colloquia, students will develop public health interventions that address a public health issue of a particular community.
courses.restrictions: Students must be enrolled in the College Park Scholars Global Public Health (CPGH) program
